title: ADHD Approved
body: I have adult ADHD and I need something to keep all my things together, both work and personal. This app/program allows me to have it! It is simply amazing. Takes a bit of time to get it working the way you want, but it allows you to customise it in almost every way. AI and voice implementation would be a great addition, but right now for a sales professional with adhd there is nothing better
author: Slickwik777
